protocol.candidates: per case (all 26 testing/ts-*): union of (a) regulations of testing/<case>/expected.json, (b) regulations in runs/<case>/{c2-base,c2-vet2,c2-v2}/upper_bound.json, regulations.json selected and citation_hop.json vetted.add (those runs that exist; c2-v2 exists for the 10 tune cases only), (c) 2 distractors: the regulations outside (a)+(b) whose card text (title + scope + contents, runs/_cards) has the highest TF-IDF cosine similarity (sublinear tf, smooth idf, over the 56 cards) with technical_spec.md. Shuffled; the source of a candidate is never shown.
protocol.adjudicator: DeepSeek (LLM_MODEL of .env, deepseek-flash), thinking disabled, temperature 0.7, via eval/xprovider.py request_for/post/reply_text; nothing from cases/ or subgoal/ is sent
protocol.input_per_request: technical_spec.md; for each candidate in the request its card (catalog card_text) + the FULL verbatim scope paragraph 1 and sub-paragraphs (regcomp parse of the base PDF the agent uses) + the supersession note
protocol.samples: 3 independent samples per candidate; each sample shuffles the candidates of the case with its own seed and cuts them in batches of at most 4 (one request per batch), so batch-mates differ between samples
protocol.decision: applies when >=2 of 3 votes say yes; contested when the vote is 2-1 either way
protocol.system_prompt:
You are a type-approval engineer at a UNECE technical service. You decide, for one product and one UN Regulation at a time, whether the Regulation applies to the product, i.e. whether you would list it in the type-approval test plan for this product.

Rules (fixed):
- Decide only from the product specification and the Regulation text given (card, verbatim scope paragraph, supersession note). Do not use other knowledge about which regulations 'usually' go with such a product.
- A Regulation applies when the product, or a sub-assembly or function of it, falls inside the scope as the scope text prints it, including the vehicle categories the scope names. It does not apply when the scope excludes the product's vehicle category or kind of product.
- Expert convention 1: cite the current regulation, not a superseded one. A Regulation marked SUPERSEDED (its provisions now sit in another Regulation) does not apply; its successor is the one to cite.
- Expert convention 2: a horizontal regulation such as electromagnetic compatibility (UN R10) applies only if the product contains electrical or electronic sub-assemblies (powered electronics, control units, sensors, wiring harnesses with electronics, LED drivers and the like). A purely passive or mechanical product does not trigger it.
- Judge every Regulation of the request separately.
Answer with JSON only: {"decisions": [{"regulation": "<id as given>", "applies": "yes" or "no", "scope_clause": "<short verbatim quote from the scope text that decides it>", "product_part": "<the part or function of the product it concerns, or 'none'>", "reason": "<one line>"}]}
quality_report: share of candidates where all 3 samples agree
15 random decisions read by hand against the scope text (seeded, reported honestly)
protocol.scoring: eval/score_audited.py: regulation P/R/F1/F2 of a run against the original gold and against the audited positive set (majority yes); page-level diagnostic on regulations both accept; macro mean and sample std over cases, split by testing/_split.json
